name: effectplan-workspace
description: EffectPlan feasibility prototype: Rust/WASM planner core plus the @effectplan/core npm wrapper

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:js && node scripts/build-package.mjs
scripts.verify:package: node scripts/build-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-size.mjs && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.test:timing-properties: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --min 7 --pattern "critical path properties" .tsbuild/packages/core/test/property.test.js
scripts.test:timing-overflow: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --min 4 --pattern "overflow|will not fit|cannot represent|zero duration" .tsbuild/packages/core/test/timing.test.js .tsbuild/packages/core/test/wasm.test.js
scripts.test:resource-oracle: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --min 5 --pattern "resource schedules against an independent reference" .tsbuild/packages/core/test/resource-schedule.test.js
scripts.test:resource-layout: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --min 3 --pattern "capacity-resource regions|read-only data below the arena|contiguous arena" .tsbuild/packages/core/test/api.test.js .tsbuild/packages/core/test/wasm.test.js
scripts.test:session-resources: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --min 6 --pattern "capacity resources|demand|whole graph|domain" .tsbuild/packages/core/test/session.test.js
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && npm run benchmark:native && npm run benchmark:ts
scripts.benchmark:ts: npm run build:js && tsc -p tsconfig.bench.json && node .tsbuild/benchmarks/initial-benchmark.js
scripts.benchmark:incremental: npm run build:js && tsc -p tsconfig.bench.json && node .tsbuild/benchmarks/incremental-benchmark.js
scripts.benchmark:headroom: npm run build:js && tsc -p tsconfig.bench.json && node .tsbuild/benchmarks/optimization-headroom.js
scripts.prototype:strategies: npm run build:js && tsc -p tsconfig.bench.json && node .tsbuild/benchmarks/strategy-prototype.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:js && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.bench.json --noEmit
